title: 9. APT Case Study — APT29 (SolarWinds, 2020)
objective: Study-guide review — ICCS423 v2 — L21: Threat Intelligence & MITRE ATT&CK: 9. APT Case Study — APT29 (SolarWinds, 2020).

blocks.text: Background: Late 2019 to early 2020, APT29 (Cozy Bear, attributed to Russia/SVR) injected the SUNBURST backdoor into SolarWinds Orion's build pipeline. SolarWinds Orion is network management software used by 18,000+ organizations including US Treasury, DHS, Microsoft, FireEye.
Discovered: December 2020 by FireEye, who noticed their own red team tools had been stolen.

rows: Backdoor disguised as normal SolarWinds component

blocks.text: Key takeaway: this single campaign maps across 6+ tactics, demonstrating that real attackers loop and chain techniques. Defenders who detect any one technique (e.g., anomalous DLL signing) can break the chain.

attribution: Course: ICCS423 | Source: Thoth + RAG | Target: 3rd-4th year CS | Date: 2026-05-03
